name: Half-open Voxel Occupancy Test
aliases: Half-open depth interval for voxel selection
definition: A voxel selection method using a half-open interval [min, max) along the depth normal to ensure each voxel belongs to exactly one of two consecutive fills, preventing gaps or overlaps at boundaries.
summary: The Half-open Voxel Occupancy Test is a voxel selection method using a half-open depth interval to prevent gaps or overlaps at boundaries, ensuring consistent layer counts unlike open intervals.
